asset.name: AlertDialog
asset.description: The focused confirmation surface for consequential decisions, explaining impact, separating safe from destructive actions, and resisting accidental dismissal.

requires.reason: Focus containment, inert background, and lifecycle are shared.

rationale: Distinct from Dialog because it must not close on outside click or escape without confirmation. A destructive action dismissed by a stray click is the defect this asset exists to prevent.
